subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should configured agentDir bootstrap files become prompt-context authority, or should OpenClaw keep workspace bootstrap files canonical and only warn when bootstrap-named files are misplaced in agentDir?
rationale: Both choices are plausible but have different security and compatibility tradeoffs, and current open PRs implement different policies.

options.title: Choose warning-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep workspace bootstrap files canonical, land a warning/docs path, and leave per-agent prompt customization to per-agent workspace configuration.

options.title: Choose explicit agentDir loading
options.body: Allow configured agentDir files to merge or override workspace bootstrap files, but require precedence docs, doctor/diagnostic alignment, focused tests, and real-run proof.

options.title: Keep the issue open for design
options.body: Pause all linked PRs until maintainers settle the prompt-authority and upgrade policy in one canonical design comment.

recommendation.title: Choose warning-only diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep workspace bootstrap files canonical, land a warning/docs path, and leave per-agent prompt customization to per-agent workspace configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and heavily maintained the bootstrap resolver and workspace docs touched by either policy choice.
